work_history.feelings: When I was full time in the pharmacy it was very stressful I was under stress every day and I was constantly trying to memorize task how to perform them and write them down because in that environment the only the rule was I only tell you once and you better remember it I wrote down so much information so that way I can remember not being burnt into anyone cuz I did not want that negativity on me and what really made it tough as a pharmacy technician was that my pharmacist my first pharmacist would like really criticize me a lot when I was performing my duties correctly or I would have like a a mishap a small mishap and then she'll lecture me and I will go home crying in the future when I was working as a pharmacy technician during college it was much more difficult because trying to go from a class to then go to the work at the pharmacy or 8 hours and come back and try to do homework I was just tired at the end of the day I would just come back to the pharmacy eat and then go to bed I would not really get work done on the weekends and I was falling behind so it was really tough but when I got demoted down to pharmacy customer associate I thought it was a lot it was so much easier and it was so relieving the reason I took it was because it was just a dollar deducted pay grade so to others they don't want that to me I'm fine with it because of time so most of my duties were restocking the shelves cleaning organizing changing the price tags answering customer concerns answering phone calls Printing and restocking and then just update my shift lead on what I've done and I was really it I was really satisfied with that
